entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I ask, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I honestly don't use it. I just want my money back.

I understand. For situations like this, some customers find our VeloFit resale marketplace to be a good option. But I can absolutely check on the official return eligibility for you. Can I get your order number?
VF-9914-25B. I don't want a marketplace, I want a return. Is that possible, yes or no?
Yes, let me check that for you right now. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It was delivered on December 15th, so that's 32 days ago. Let me just confirm the policy.
Alright, I've checked. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you.
Great. What do I need to do?

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. You just need to package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at a post office. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
Okay, I see the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else for you today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
